entries.f5e2bff4d670f275: This is a single segment covering the manufacture and sale of calcium carbonate and related incidental operations. The company manufactures precipitated calcium carbonate and ground calcium carbonate, and its subsidiary Kyushu Calcium Co., Ltd. manufactures ground calcium carbonate. Sales are handled by the company, Kyushu Calcium Co., Ltd. and Maruo (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which also sell ground calcium carbonate purchased from related party Chūgoku Kōgyō Co., Ltd. and inorganic chemicals such as talc and silica. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,639 million.
